subject: Implement 16-bit SSE2 & AVX2 vector division (#94)
perf_evidence: Commit replaces per-lane scalar fallback with SIMD division algorithms for 16-bit vectors.
change_summary: Implements 128-bit SSE2 and 256-bit AVX2 signed/unsigned 16-bit division paths.

units.name: public 128-bit vector division, four signed/unsigned modes with generated dividers
units.evidence: Unsigned branchfull passes both directions; the other three generated-divider API targets time out.

units.name: public 256-bit vector division, four signed/unsigned modes with generated dividers
units.evidence: Signed branchfree passes both directions; the other three generated-divider API targets time out.

units.name: raw 16-bit vector division with arbitrary divider fields
units.evidence: One raw signed branchfree mode passes; two unsigned raw modes have only a one-way proof and another times out. This does not establish a generated-divider API result.

notes: All four API modes at each vector width were attempted, but six of eight API proofs remain inconclusive. The scalar per-lane implementation existed before the commit, so this is a changed implementation of an existing API rather than a new API.
